retrospectiveInvoked.Evidence:
## Retrospective

Learnings captured:
1. subprocess.run text=True uses platform-default encoding; prefer explicit encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'.
2. FileNotFoundError from subprocess.run differs from bash 127 exit; all run_command wrappers need this catch.
3. Health status in diagnostic scripts must be monotonic to prevent masking severe failures.
